annotation.title_clean: Proyecto de Ley: Información y Responsabilidad de Proveedores en el Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill: Information and Liability of Providers in the Use of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Pamela Calletti, Diputada Nacional (Honorable Cámara de Diputados de la Nación, Argentina)
annotation.venue: Honorable Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina
annotation.summary_en: Argentine bill amending the Consumer Protection Law 24.240 to require providers to disclose AI use to consumers, explain how systems work, avoid discriminatory bias, and bear aggravated liability for harm from automated decisions, with administrative sanctions. It is general AI consumer protection with no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Art. 4 and 8 of Ley 24.240 to require disclosure of AI use in products, services, images, audio and video
Providers must be transparent, explain how the system works and what data it uses
Providers must ensure AI does not perpetuate discriminatory bias
Providers liable for harm from automated decisions, with sanctions under art. 47 including fines and suspension
